title: Gabber's root condition implies lifting of sections of etale algebras
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $I\subseteq A$ an ideal such that (a) $I$ is contained in the Jacobson radical of $A$, and (b) every monic polynomial $f(T)=T^n(T-1)+a_nT^n+\dots+a_1T+a_0\in A[T]$ with $n\ge1$ and $a_0,\dots,a_n\in I$ has a root $\alpha\in1+I$. Then for every ring map $A\to A'$ such that $\operatorname{Spec}A'\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] and every $A$-algebra map $\sigma:A'\to A/I$ there is an $A$-algebra map $\tau:A'\to A$ whose composite with the quotient map $A\to A/I$ is $\sigma$.
